verdict.rationale: Apple provides official SDKs relevant to AI-native development on the M4 Pro chip — Metal (GPU compute/ML debugging), Core ML, MLX, and PyTorch backend support — all documented on developer.apple.com. However, this is first-party documentation only with no independent or hands-on corroboration of actually building against these SDKs, and no agent-specific tooling is mentioned. Missing for 10: independent developer corroboration, hands-on build examples, and any agentic/AI-agent-specific SDK features.
